value.rationale: A natural proposed transplantation of acceleration from deterministic trace probing to nested Monte Carlo trace means loses all absolute moments of order >=1, for every nonzero PSD matrix, despite finite-moment inputs. The exact 1/t coefficient and inverse-ridge MSE law provide substantive risk and calibration information; the simplest isotropic 2x2 case yields sharp constants.
